name: Exploded UI Layers
description: A product screen splits into four floating layers — workspace, data, interface, insights — under an isometric camera that tilts and drifts, each layer labelled, then the stack collapses back into one flat screen.
move: A product screen splits into four floating layers — workspace, data, interface, insights — under an isometric camera that tilts and drifts, each layer labelled, then the stack collapses back into one flat screen.
how: Deterministic draw(t). A preserve-3d world holds four layer planes; the camera is rotateX/rotateZ on Flow quart in-out, layers separate along Z on a damped spring (staggered upward) and fall back in reverse order. A permanent 1.5px Z step per layer keeps coplanar layers from z-fighting.
adapt: Swap the layer contents and tag names; GAP sets the separation. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time. Sound: fx.sfx() cues in the film cue-sheet format; the render muxes them and sfx.json is the sheet to reuse in a film (offset by the shot start).
caveats: Original implementation of a common SaaS launch-film move; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
